name: garden-skills
description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
summary: 康拉德·李开源技能集，涵盖网页设计、知识检索、图像生成等
categoryDescription: 官方或社区维护的 Skills、插件与资源目录
categoryReason: 名称或作者描述明确说明是目录/合集
howToUse: 先在仓库目录中选择目标 Skill，再按 README 将对应目录复制或安装到你的 Agent Skills 目录。
installCommand:
npx skills add ConardLi/garden-skills
npx skills add ConardLi/garden-skills -s web-design-engineer
npx skills add ConardLi/garden-skills -s gpt-image-2 --global
